files.name: SeekLog.java

help: seek_log: walk toward remembered or new woods until a log is within 40 blocks (after collect log saw none)
lesson: collect log NOT_FOUND repeats because collect only looks 3 s within 64 blocks while explore log says ALREADY_DONE for logs seen further away; a step that closes that gap until collect's own check passes should end the two-refusal loop.
summary: seek_log: after collect log fails NOT_FOUND (or explore log says ALREADY_DONE), walk to the nearest remembered log beyond collect's 64-block range, or walk 40-block legs to find one, ending once a log is within 40 blocks.
